_source: Not a capture. Built from Zoho's published OpenAPI files (https://github.com/zoho/zohodesk-oas, v1.0/Ticket.json: getTicketsByContact takes departmentId, sortBy (-createdTime for newest first) and limit, and answers 200 with a data list or 204), with the ticket properties of zoho-ticket.json. Every value is fake; the second ticket is another deployment's with the same EM- number. find_adoptable reads the subject of each ticket in this list, so the list must carry it; scripts/zoho/test_ticket.py checks that on the real answer. scripts/zoho/probe.py and scripts/zoho/test_ticket.py replace this file with a masked capture.
